newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-TASMANIA SHEFFIELD SHIELD THIRD DAY SCORE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TASMANIA SHEFFIELD SHIELD THIRD DAY SCORE.

text.p: Score at the close of play on Sunday, the third day of a four day Sheffield Shield match at the Bellerive Oval between Tasmania and Western Australia.
Tasmania - 314 (Jamie Cox 96, Michael DiVenuto 65) and 175 (Tom Moody seven for 41)
Western Australia - 312 (Mike Hussey 83, Ryan Campbell 78, Mark Ridgway four for 88) and 27-0.
